method: Until now show cards printed the shipped blend score (a rank percentile) as "N% match", right next to movie cards whose percent is a tested chance. Same look, different meaning. This test decides which one a show card is allowed to show. Same data, matching, item-kNN, and blend as training/confirm_tv_blend.py. A fresh random group of people (seed 41) with 3+ loved movies and 1+ rated show is held out; similarities come only from everyone else. Each held-out person's loved movies rank every show, exactly as the app does. Every show the person rated (any stars) is a data point: its top-% rank, and whether they gave it 4+ stars ("if you watch it, how likely are you to love it?"). Isotonic regression maps rank to chance, fit on half the people and checked once on the other half.
